properties.description: Construction of the Chelan Wet Weather Storage Tank located at 4034 West Marginal Way SW. There will be a new above-grade 4,995-sf one-story facility building (approx. 111-ft x 45-ft) with a concrete slab foundation on structural fill that will include: a 1,400-sf generator room (approx. 25-ft x 56-ft), a 1,258-sf electrical room (approx. 17-ft x 74-ft), a 48-sf restroom (approx. 6-ft x 8-ft), a 240-sf communication room (approx. 15-ft x 16-ft), and a 1,247-sf C2 room (approx. 29-ft x 43-ft) with a utility area, hydropneumatics tank, C2 booster pumps, tipping bucket valves, and air gap tank. A new above grade 2,250-sf architecturally screened odor control area (approx. 50-ft x 45-ft) with a concrete slab foundation on structural fill that will include: architectural screening (approx. 10-ft in height), dual bed scrubber, enclosed fan, filter, raised platform, and roof access. A new above-grade 4,200-sf one-story tipping bucket enclosure (approx. 300-ft x 13-ft) with a concrete slab foundation on structural fill. The new building footprint areas total 11,445-sf (facility building, screened odor control area, and tipping bucket enclosure). New at-grade impervious pavement areas and landscaping that include: an 11,514-sf fire apparatus road, a 3,857-sf maintenance access road, and 1,143-sf of parking with 6 stalls total (2 EV and 4 for maintenance). A new 7,078-sf stormwater bioretention cell providing water quality and infiltration for targeted surfaces and 1,066 linear feet of new fencing to include 2 new vehicular access gates. A new below-grade 37,500-sf, 7 MG storage tank (approx. 300-ft x 125-ft) with structural fill foundation material and associated channels and mechanical facilities that include: five flushing channels, a collection channel, and pump sump. There will be new access hatches (4 total) and a new 288-sf drain pump vault (approx. 12-ft x 24-ft). The new construction areas total is 68,950-sf with new and replaced impervious surfaces totaling 66,570-sf with total site excavation of 81,900-cy.

properties.description: The Republic Hotel is a historic URM building in the International Special Review District. It is a mixed-use retail and 100% Affordable Housing project that is on the Priority 2 list. The scope of work includes voluntary full seismic upgrades, masonry restoration, window replacement and restoration, adding an elevator, new roofing, and adding a 5th floor penthouse floor. Mechanical and electrical upgrades include new exhaust fans, new heat pumps for heating and cooling, low flow plumbing fixtures, new all building hot and cold water plumbing system, all LED lighting, a new fire sprinkler system, a new fire alarm system. Interior improvements include new cabinets and counter tops, Energy Star appliances, tubs/showers, new flooring, base, and paint throughout. cold shell for the commercial spaces. All new insulation on entire exterior envelope as part of the work. We are looking at 36 family sized units over retail/restaurant space.

properties.description:
The project is identified as the Home of the Upper School (HoUS) includes (5) stories of academic spaces; one level of below grade parking, storage and mechanical spaces; a mechanical penthouse; and an outdoor community space that will serve as a connector to other buildings on the block).  The academic floors will incorporate classrooms for grades 9 - 12, spaces that support upper school students outside the classroom, administrative spaces, community areas including a cafeteria and students commons, innovation spaces with a shop for metal and woodworking, student workspaces and a digital fabrication lab. Student collaboration spaces are integrated to compliment academic spaces throughout the building. The proposed new Upper School facility will be located along 12th Avenue between the existing Seattle Academy Vanderbilt building and the Seattle Academy Arts building. The project will connect to the existing SAAS campus while creating a unique new home and front door for the Upper School program.

The project site is comprised of parcels F, H1, H2 and H3 of Government Lot 2, Section 32, Township 25 North, Range 4 East, W.M., in King County, Washington.  (PCL# 322504-9017, 322504-9019 and 322504-9020) and portions of Parcel A Lots 11,12 and 13 of supplementary Edes and Knight's Add., according the plat recorded in volume 2 of plats at page(s) 194, in King County, Washington.  Please see Attachment A:  Site Plan

The site contains existing structures, which will be demolished and include:
	The Seattle Academy Dilbert & Inez Roberts one-story, 19,775 SF storage warehouse at 1120 12th Avenue
	The Seattle Academy Mother's Place one story structures located at 1118 12th Avenue
	A Seattle Academy concrete surface parking lot at 1120 12th Avenue

properties.description:
Seattle Public Utilities is completing improvements to Pump Station 17 located at 410 S Norfolk St (address on application is incorrect, but matches SDOT UMP 404627). Scope includes a Mechanical Permit (6739751-ME) and the following structural and civil improvements: 
·   Wet well: replace grating, railing, and beams. Install new ladder from surface down to wet well.

·   Dry well: install toe boards where required.

·   Expand dry well platform and retrofit ladders/stairs as needed for variable frequency drive (VFD) cabinets.

·   Provide hinged grating openings with a hold-open over each pump to accommodate full removal. Include pop-out sections to pass cables without needing to bend grating.

·   Assess existing retaining wall, conduct survey monitoring, and provide long term recommendation.

·   Install new wet well and dry well hatches; leave stairway hatch.

·   Provide hatch cover for existing lift slab.
